```{=html}
<div class="contact-shell">

  <div class="contact-left">
    <p class="contact-label"></p>

    <h1 class="contact-title">Let’s <em>talk</em></h1>

    <div class="contact-badge">
      <span class="contact-badge-dot"></span>
      Currently exploring new opportunities

      collaboration, and opportunities where business, technology, and data come together.

    </p>

    <form class="contact-form" action="#" method="post">

      <input type="email" name="email" placeholder="Your email">
      <textarea name="message" rows="3" placeholder="Your message..."></textarea>

      <button type="submit" class="contact-submit">
        SEND MESSAGE ↗

  </div>

  <div class="contact-right">

      </div>

    <div class="contact-card">
```
